article.title: A Behavior Change Technique-Based Text Messaging Intervention for Obesity Among Employed Adult Men Younger Than 40 Years: Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial.
article.abstract: In Japan, employed men younger than 40 years are not eligible for specific health guidance, and evidence regarding obesity interventions targeting this population is limited. Furthermore, due to the shortage of human resources in occupational health settings, a need has arisen for simple and implementable support methods. Support via SMS text message is expected to be a low-cost and scalable method for health guidance; however, its effectiveness in this target population has not been sufficiently evaluated.
